primary_request: A few years later: a teenager practices guitar every day in a small bedroom, rain or shine, surrounded by records.

input_images.role: character reference only: keep the teenager's look (pose 2: short dark bob covering the face, cornflower-blue shirt, mustard-yellow cable-knit sweater vest, walnut-brown trousers) and the flat print style; do not copy the sheet layout or the other poses

scene: a teenager's small bedroom: on the left wall a large window with a completely plain, empty sky (one flat light color, no clouds, no buildings, so it can be recolored later); along the back wall a tall shelf filled with rows of vinyl records and CDs (spines only, no writing); a desk on the right with big over-ear headphones, a stack of music theory books and a classic pyramid-shaped mechanical metronome standing clearly visible on the desk; a single bed with a plain cover
subject: the same person from the reference as a teenager (about 15), sitting on the edge of the bed in the center-left, seen from the side with the head bowed toward the fretboard so the dark bob hair hides the face, playing an acoustic guitar
composition: wide interior shot, straight-on; the window fully visible on the left third, the teenager in the center-left, the metronome on the desk at the right; the upper-right wall area above the desk is calm and empty for lyric text; clear foreground / middle / background layers for parallax
lighting: neutral daylight coming from the window, simple flat shadow shapes
palette: mainly teal (#00838A), cornflower blue (#62A8E5) and mustard yellow (#FFB511) on warm off-white paper (#F3ECDD), walnut brown (#925F52) for wood; a few small fluorescent pink (#FF48B0) accents on record sleeves; no other hues
